name: Icon Fix
description:
Shows the proper icon and name for Steam games and other apps that GNOME can't match to their .desktop file, so you no longer have to add StartupWMClass to every game by hand.

Works with the dock (including Dash to Dock), Alt+Tab and the overview. It matches windows the way KDE does: by Steam app ID (including non-Steam shortcuts), window class, process or Wine/Proton .exe name, and window title. Your .desktop files are never modified.
